text: Find the equation of the plane through (4,0,1), (3,5,0) and (4,3,0).

points.text: Two vectors in the plane are $-\hat{i} + 5\hat{j} - \hat{k}$ and $3\hat{j} - \hat{k}$.
Their cross product gives the normal: $-2\hat{i} - \hat{j} - 3\hat{k}$.
Dividing out the common factor and using the first point, the plane is $2x + y + 3z = 11$.
